deploy-bot: STARTING config-only canary 1728202020 — rolling out routing/batching/timeout tweak to a small slice :rocket:

deploy-bot: params -> routing_policy=weighted, routing.weight=0.05, batch_window_ms=40, max_batch_tokens=1500, default_timeout_ms=2500, change_window=20m

Sophia: ack. I'm on obs and will watch latency + error rate. :eyes:

James: noted. Can we pin traffic to the 'stable' model variant? This is config-only but want to avoid accidental model reshuffle.

Mike: no model change here, but adding a pin is cheap. I'm adding routing.pin=stable-2026-01 in the canary group.

Elaine: alert rules I care about: 99p latency > 350ms OR error_rate > 0.5% over 5m -> DM @oncall and auto rollback. I'll attach the query in a sec.

Sophia: thumbs up. Also watching kv-cache hit rate — small batches sometimes change cache pressure.

James: quick sanity check — what does the rollback command look like? posting runbook snippet:

```
# rollback to previous config
./infra/deploy revert --target canary-group-1728202020 --to-config-id prev-config-1728120000
# or via console: Release -> canary -> revert
```

Mike: if we see high tail latency we'll drain canary and drop weight to 0 immediately. Plan: 5% -> 0% in 1 min, then postmortem.

Ops-bot: canary created (id=canary-1728202020). Logs: http://internal.ci/canary/canary-1728202020 :link:

Elaine: alert query posted — metric name: inference.responses.errors_ratio, window: 5m, eval: rate>0.005. Also added 99p latency dashboard panel.

Sophia: two quick asks: 1) enable trace sampling for canary=100% for 20m, 2) capture 5 example requests that hit new routing path for eval set.

Mike: done — trace sampling bump enabled. Listing sample capture job: `tools/trace-capture --group canary-1728202020 --limit 5`

deploy-bot: CANARY IN PROGRESS — currently at 5% traffic. Will report status at +10m and +20m. If conditions met, will bump to 20% then stable.

James: I'll keep an eye on tenant SLOs and notify infra if any cross-tenant contention appears. :thumbsup:

Sophia: if no regressions at +20m, we move to 20% for 30m then schedule full rollout after approval. Otherwise rollback plan stands.

Ops-bot: monitoring hooks live. Posting quick checklist: [x] pin, [x] alerts, [x] tracing, [x] runbook link, [x] rollback cmd.

Elaine: adding small note to release-channel: "Config tweak: tighter per-request timeout and slightly smaller batch window to reduce tail latency. Canary 5% -> 20% if green."

Sophia: thanks — I'll stay on until +30m. :coffee:

Mike: if anyone sees sudden CPU growth on serving hosts ping me, prepping to revert routing.weight and batch_window.

deploy-bot: UPDATE @ 1728202620 — canary metrics: errors=0.12%, 99p latency=312ms, kv-cache hit stable. No auto-rollback triggers. Next check in 10m.

Sophia: good so far. continuing to watch. :eyes:

James: ready to approve bump at +20m unless anyone objects.

(No further objections in thread)

deploy-bot: BUMP -> canary now at 20% (canary-1728202020). Will monitor for 30m before scheduling broader roll."
